concept: Hoppy and industrial taproom energy: a deep golden-amber primary (the glow of a fresh pour) snaps against warm cream backgrounds and near-black ink, with a deep teal accent for an electric, fun, factory-floor edge.
contrastNotes: All AA thresholds hold. ink #15120C on bg #FBF5E8 = 17.2:1 (>=7). ink-soft #5C5340 on bg = 6.99:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #A85A00 = 5.09:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 4.68:1 (>=3). Extras: primary-dark #7E4300 on bg = 7.19:1 and white on primary-dark = 7.81:1 for AA-large/body CTAs; white on teal accent/secondary #0E4D52 = 9.54:1; ink on surface = 18.69:1, on surface-alt = 15.48:1; ink-soft on surface-alt = 6.29:1.
